"""Generate the declared ideal16-level3dB AY table, not measured hardware data."""
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext, ROUND_FLOOR
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
with localcontext() as ctx:
    ctx.prec = 70
    values = [0] + [int((Decimal(32767) * Decimal(10) ** (Decimal(3) * (i - 15) / 20)).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)) for i in range(1, 16)]
text = '\\ Original ideal3dB AY model levels, not measured chip DAC data.\nCREATE ZX-LEVELS\n'
text += '\n'.join(' '.join(str(v) + ' ,' for v in values[i:i + 8]) for i in range(0, 16, 8)) + '\n'
p = argparse.ArgumentParser(); p.add_argument('--check', action='store_true'); args = p.parse_args()
target = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'examples/zx-ay-levels.fs'
if args.check:
    if target.read_text(encoding='utf-8') != text: raise SystemExit('AY level table is stale')
else: target.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print('16 ideal AY levels reproduced')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent CPU-tick/16-level AY oracle and exhaustive ZX audio port checks; no audio."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, math, platform, struct, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
LEVELS = [0] + [math.floor(32767 * 10 ** (3 * (i - 15) / 20)) for i in range(1, 16)]
MASKS = [255,15,255,15,255,15,31,255,31,31,31,255,255,15,255]
VARS = ['MODEL','CPU','ULA','PINS','NOISE-COUNT','NOISE-HALF','LFSR','ENV-COUNT','ENV-STEP','ENV-ATTACK','ENV-HOLD','ENV-ALTERNATE','ENV-HOLDING','CYCLE','DIV','FRACTION','SELECT','EVENT-COUNT','EVENT-INDEX']
DUMP = ': SNAP 16 0 DO I ZX-R@ . LOOP 3 0 DO ZX-TONE-COUNT I CELLS + @ . LOOP 3 0 DO ZX-TONE-HIGH I CELLS + @ . LOOP '+' '.join('ZX-'+v+' @ .' for v in VARS)+' ;\n'


class Model:
    def __init__(self, mode):
        self.mode=mode; self.cpu=3546895 if mode else 3500000
        self.r=[0]*16; self.tc=[0]*3; self.th=[False]*3
        self.ula=0; self.pins=255; self.nc=self.nh=0; self.lfsr=1
        self.ec=0; self.half=0; self.level=15; self.attack=0
        self.hold=True; self.alt=False; self.held=True; self.reset_env=True
        self.t=self.div=self.frac=self.select=0

    def step(self):
        for i in range(3):
            self.tc[i]+=1
            if self.tc[i]>=max(1,self.r[i*2]+256*self.r[i*2+1]): self.tc[i]=0; self.th[i]=not self.th[i]
        self.nh=1-self.nh
        if self.nh:
            self.nc+=1
            if self.nc>=max(1,self.r[6]):
                self.nc=0; self.lfsr=(self.lfsr//2)|(((self.lfsr^(self.lfsr//8))&1)<<16)
        if not self.held:
            self.ec+=1
            if self.ec>=max(1,self.r[11]+256*self.r[12]):
                self.ec=0; self.half=1-self.half
                if self.half==0:
                    if self.level: self.level-=1
                    else:
                        if self.alt: self.attack=15-self.attack
                        if self.hold: self.held=True
                        else: self.level=15

    def advance(self, tick):
        assert tick>=self.t
        while self.t<tick and self.mode:
            self.t+=1; self.div+=1
            if self.div==16: self.div=0; self.step()
        self.t=tick

    def reg(self, reg, value):
        self.r[reg]=value&MASKS[reg]
        if reg==13:
            shape=self.r[13]; self.attack=15 if shape&4 else 0
            self.hold=bool(shape&1) if shape&8 else True
            self.alt=bool(shape&2) if shape&8 else bool(self.attack)
            self.level=15; self.half=self.ec=0; self.held=self.reset_env=False

    def store(self, value, target):
        if target<15: self.reg(target,value)
        elif target==15: self.pins=value
        else:
            port=target-16
            if port%2==0: self.ula=value
            if self.mode and port//32768 and not(port//2%2):
                if port//16384%2: self.select=value
                elif self.select<15: self.reg(self.select,value)

    def sample(self):
        result=4096 if self.ula&16 else 0
        if self.mode:
            channels=[]
            for i in range(3):
                gate=(self.th[i] or bool(self.r[7]&(1<<i))) and (bool(self.lfsr&1) or bool(self.r[7]&(8<<i)))
                level=(self.level^self.attack) if self.r[8+i]&16 else self.r[8+i]&15
                channels.append(LEVELS[level] if gate else 0)
            result+=sum(channels)//6
        return result

    def render(self, frames, events):
        pending=list(events); index=0; out=bytearray()
        for _ in range(frames):
            advance,self.frac=divmod(self.frac+self.cpu,48000); end=self.t+advance
            while index<len(pending) and pending[index][0]<=end:
                tick,value,target=pending[index]; self.advance(tick); self.store(value,target); index+=1
            self.advance(end); out.extend(struct.pack('<h',self.sample()))
        return bytes(out)

    def state(self):
        step=31 if self.reset_env else 0 if self.held else self.level*2+1-self.half
        return self.r+self.tc+[-int(v) for v in self.th]+[self.mode,self.cpu,self.ula,self.pins,self.nc,self.nh,self.lfsr,self.ec,step,31 if self.attack else 0,-int(self.hold),-int(self.alt),-int(self.held),self.t,self.div,self.frac,self.select]


def queue(events):
    return '\n'.join(f'{value} {target-16} {tick} ZX-OUT-EVENT!' if target>=16 else f'{value} {tick} ZX-INPUT-EVENT!' if target==15 else f'{value} {target} {tick} ZX-AY-EVENT!' for tick,value,target in events)+'\n'

    binary=args.sigma.resolve(); work=ROOT/'.work/1169'; work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); tests=[]

    for mode in [0,1]:

  clean=' '.join(line for line in q.stdout.decode().splitlines() if not line.startswith('WARNING:')).strip()
  assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr and clean==expected+' 0',(name,q.returncode,clean,q.stderr)
  results.append({'case':name,'result':clean})

\ Original Forth-only synthesis workload for task999. NOT a hardware emulator.
\ Loading only defines words: it does not open audio or play anything.
\ 4 voices; Q24 phase; fixed 48000 Hz mono signed16 little-endian output.
DECIMAL
48000 CONSTANT PS-RATE
16777216 CONSTANT PS-TURN
CREATE PS-KIND 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-STEP 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-GAIN 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-DUTY 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-PHASE 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-NOISE 4 CELLS ALLOT
: PS-AT ( voice base -- addr ) SWAP CELLS + ;
: PS-VOICE? ( voice -- ) 0 4 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN ;
: PS-RESET ( -- )
  4 0 DO
    0 I PS-KIND PS-AT ! 0 I PS-STEP PS-AT !
    0 I PS-GAIN PS-AT ! 128 I PS-DUTY PS-AT !
    0 I PS-PHASE PS-AT ! 1 I PS-NOISE PS-AT !
  LOOP ;
\ Write (value voice register): 0 kind(0mute/1pulse/2triangle/3noise),
\ 1 Hz(0..23999), 2 peak gain(0..8191), 3 pulse duty(1..255 /256).
\ Validate all arguments before changing state; other fields/phase stay intact.
: PS-REG! ( value voice register -- )
  OVER PS-VOICE?
  DUP 0 4 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  DUP 0= IF DROP OVER 0 4 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN PS-KIND PS-AT ! EXIT THEN
  DUP 1 = IF DROP OVER 0 24000 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
    SWAP PS-TURN * PS-RATE / SWAP PS-STEP PS-AT ! EXIT THEN
  DUP 2 = IF DROP OVER 0 8192 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN PS-GAIN PS-AT ! EXIT THEN
  DROP OVER 1 256 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN PS-DUTY PS-AT ! ;
: PS-LFSR ( u -- u ) DUP DUP 1 RSHIFT XOR 1 AND 15 LSHIFT SWAP 1 RSHIFT OR ;
: PS-VOICE ( voice -- sample )
  DUP PS-PHASE PS-AT @ OVER PS-STEP PS-AT @ +
  DUP PS-TURN >= IF
    OVER PS-NOISE PS-AT DUP @ PS-LFSR SWAP !
  THEN
  PS-TURN 1- AND DUP 2 PICK PS-PHASE PS-AT !
  OVER PS-KIND PS-AT @
  DUP 0= IF DROP 2DROP 0 EXIT THEN
  DUP 1 = IF DROP OVER PS-DUTY PS-AT @ 65536 * <
    IF PS-GAIN PS-AT @ ELSE PS-GAIN PS-AT @ NEGATE THEN EXIT THEN
  2 = IF
    14 RSHIFT DUP 512 < IF 128 * 32768 - ELSE 128 * 98304 SWAP - THEN
    SWAP PS-GAIN PS-AT @ * 32768 / EXIT THEN
  DROP DUP PS-NOISE PS-AT @ 1 AND IF PS-GAIN PS-AT @ ELSE PS-GAIN PS-AT @ NEGATE THEN ;
: PS-SAMPLE ( -- n ) 0 4 0 DO I PS-VOICE + LOOP ;
: PS-LE! ( n addr -- ) OVER 255 AND OVER C! SWAP 8 RSHIFT 255 AND SWAP 1+ C! ;
\ Caller supplies a valid destination of frames*2 bytes; no audio host needed.
: PS-RENDER ( addr frames -- ) DUP 0< IF -24 THROW THEN 0 ?DO PS-SAMPLE OVER PS-LE! 2 + LOOP DROP ;
: PS-DEMO-SETUP ( -- )
  PS-RESET
  1 0 0 PS-REG! 440 0 1 PS-REG! 2000 0 2 PS-REG! 64 0 3 PS-REG!
  1 1 0 PS-REG! 660 1 1 PS-REG! 2000 1 2 PS-REG!
  2 2 0 PS-REG! 110 2 1 PS-REG! 2000 2 2 PS-REG!
  3 3 0 PS-REG! 3000 3 1 PS-REG! 500 3 2 PS-REG! ;
PS-RESET
source_snapshots_lf.examples/pcm-synth-play.fs:
\ Explicit PCM playback wrapper for pcm-synth.fs. Loading does not play audio.
\ Run from repository root: sigma examples/pcm-synth-play.fs -e "PS-DEMO-SETUP 96 FALSE PS-STREAM BYE"
\ TRUE opts into audible output (start at low system volume).
S" examples/pcm-synth.fs" INCLUDED
REQUIRE-AUDIO ALSO AUDIO
CREATE PS-BUFFER 1024 ALLOT
VARIABLE PS-HANDLE
VARIABLE PS-BLOCKS
VARIABLE PS-AUDIBLE
VARIABLE PS-SENT
VARIABLE PS-REQUEST
VARIABLE PS-WRITES
VARIABLE PS-PARTIAL
VARIABLE PS-FULL
VARIABLE PS-WAITS
VARIABLE PS-FRAMES
VARIABLE PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT
: PS-SEND ( -- )
  0 PS-SENT !
  BEGIN 512 PS-SENT @ - DUP 0> WHILE
    DUP PS-REQUEST ! PS-BUFFER PS-SENT @ 2 * + SWAP PS-HANDLE @ PCM-WRITE THROW
    1 PS-WRITES +!
    DUP 0= IF 1 PS-FULL +! THEN
    DUP 0> IF DUP PS-REQUEST @ < IF 1 PS-PARTIAL +! THEN THEN
    DUP PS-FRAMES +! PS-SENT +!
    PS-SENT @ 512 < IF
      1 PS-WAITS +! 1 1000 PS-HANDLE @ PCM-WAIT THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN
    THEN
  REPEAT DROP ;
: PS-RUN ( -- )
  PS-RATE 1 4096 PCM-OPEN THROW PS-HANDLE !
  PS-BLOCKS @ 0 ?DO
    PS-BUFFER 512 PS-RENDER
    PS-AUDIBLE @ 0= IF PS-BUFFER 1024 0 FILL THEN
    PS-SEND
  LOOP
  1 1000 PS-HANDLE @ PCM-STOP THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN
  PS-HANDLE @ PCM-UNDERRUNS THROW PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT ! ;
\ Always attempt close after success/error. A failed close retains PS-HANDLE
\ for PS-CLEANUP retry; primary error wins if both body and cleanup fail.
: PS-CLEANUP ( -- ior )
  PS-HANDLE @ DUP 0= IF DROP 0 EXIT THEN
  PCM-CLOSE DUP 0= IF 0 PS-HANDLE ! THEN ;
: PS-SAFE-CLEANUP ( -- ior ) ['] PS-CLEANUP CATCH DUP IF EXIT THEN DROP ;
: PS-STREAM ( blocks audible -- )
  OVER 0< IF -24 THROW THEN
  PS-HANDLE @ IF -528 THROW THEN
  PS-AUDIBLE ! PS-BLOCKS !
  0 PS-WRITES ! 0 PS-PARTIAL ! 0 PS-FULL ! 0 PS-WAITS !
  0 PS-FRAMES ! 0 PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT !
  ['] PS-RUN CATCH >R PS-SAFE-CLEANUP
  R> ?DUP IF SWAP DROP THROW THEN THROW ;
